title: Old House/GREAT Location East Nashville
description:
Located in a friendly East Nashville neighborhood. Only 5 minutes from Downtown, 10 minutes from the Airport, 5 minutes to Five Points. 4 bed, 1 Bath.

The space
- Newly Remodeled 1914 kit house
- 3 Bedroom, 1 twin bed in a loft, 1 bathroom
- 1500 Square foot
- Easy access so you are able to arrive any time you want, don't need to meet to hand off the key
-Open floor plan with living room, kitchen, dining area and loft
- stove, oven and microwave
-Refrigerator 
-Pots & Pans, dishes, silverware and prep utensils
-Coffee Pot
-Dishwasher
-Fully controlled HVAC
- Free WiFi Access
- Driveway Parking

Guest access
Guest will have access throughout the entire house. The basement will be locked with our personal belongings. Guest will also have access to the driveway to park their cars, backyard and backporch.
